question_en: An E-26.02 test result has changed from its commissioning baseline. Which evidence provides the strongest basis for interpretation?
options: The current result compared with previous data, manufacturer specifications and commissioning references.
explanation_en: E-26.02 uses previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation to evaluate test results.
explanation_es: E-26.02 usa resultados previos, especificaciones del fabricante y documentación de commissioning para evaluar resultados.
